description: This file defines the RemindersService class that implements methods for listing and adding reminders using the EventKit framework in iOS. It handles authorization, fetching reminders with filtering, adding new reminders, and resolving reminder lists.

classes.name: RemindersService
classes.description: A class providing functionalities to list and add reminders via EventKit, conforming to the RemindersServicing protocol.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a list of reminders based on provided filtering parameters.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Asynchronously adds a new reminder with specified details into the selected list.

methods.name: resolveList
methods.description: Resolves and returns the EKCalendar instance based on list ID or name, or defaults if none provided.
